story.title: Meta launches enterprise AI platform, hires MongoDB CEO to lead new initiative

facts.text: Meta announced the launch of its new Meta Enterprise Platform , which it hopes will drive more business adoption of its artificial intelligence products, and provide another revenue pathway for its increasingly costly AI business.
Yahoo Finance is not a broker-dealer or investment adviser and does not offer securities or cryptocurrencies for sale or facilitate trading.
Meta's business-focused AI push comes as the company looks to establish a more direct path to profit stemming from its massive AI infrastructure investments.
"Over the coming years, AI will fundamentally redefine how organizations of all sizes innovate, grow, serve customers, and run business operations," Zuckerberg said.

"Meta has a unique role to play because it is bringing together advanced models and leading agents with a proven track record of helping millions of advertisers and hundreds of millions of businesses scale."
Former MongoDB CEO Chirantan Desai will be brought in to Meta to lead the project.
MongoDB provides enterprise database solutions.
The question then is whether businesses will trust Meta to handle their internal data.
In 2024, Meta ended its Workplace platform , which provided a Facebook-like interface for internal communications.
This year, Meta has sought to force more businesses to sign up to its new subscription packages for Facebook and Instagram by reducing the number of links that they can share in their posts .
Meta announced Monday that it’s launching “Meta Enterprise Platform,” a new initiative aimed at expanding the company’s AI offerings to businesses and corporate customers.
The social media giant hired Chirantan “CJ” Desai, the CEO of database software giant MongoDB, to lead the new initiative.

“Over the coming years, AI will fundamentally redefine how organizations of all sizes innovate, grow, serve customers, and run business operations,” Desai said in a statement. “Meta has a unique role to play because it is bringing together advanced models and leading agents with a proven track record of helping millions of advertisers and hundreds of millions of businesses scale.
The launch of the new business builds on the momentum of Muse, Meta’s personal AI assistant launched earlier this month that can perform tasks for users such as sending emails and booking travel.
The move could help Meta see a return on all the money it’s pouring into AI.
Meta launches Meta Enterprise Platform to sell AI tools to businesses and developers.
CJ Desai, MongoDB CEO, named head of enterprise platform, reporting to Mark Zuckerberg.

Meta’s newsroom post about the enterprise platform sent MongoDB shares tumbling, with 24/7 Wall St. saying MongoDB (NASDAQ:MDB) fell 19% to $333.80 after losing its chief executive to the Meta Platforms project.
Business Insider España said MongoDB’s shares plunged more than 25% following the announcement, while it said Meta investors also punished the decision with a 4% drop.
MongoDB said Desai stepped down effective Monday, and MongoDB named Dev Ittycheria as interim president and chief executive while it reorganizes its leadership.

Chirantan Desai said, "As with Muse, security and privacy are built into Meta’s enterprise products from the outset," and Proactive financial news added that Desai also said, "Our goal is to make Meta the place enterprises come to scale their businesses,".
9 of 11 outlets skipped it: muse Confidential VM aims to prevent even Meta access to contents .

Meta has appointed Chirantan “CJ” Desai , the Indian-origin Chief Executive Officer of MongoDB , to lead its newly launched Meta Enterprise Platform , marking a significant step in the company’s effort to deepen its presence in the enterprise AI market.
According to Meta, the platform will package its AI technologies into products and services that organisations can deploy across operations, customer engagement and business workflows.
The new business builds on the momentum of Muse, which Meta introduced earlier this month as an AI assistant capable of handling tasks such as sending emails and booking travel.
In a statement released by Meta, Desai said AI would fundamentally reshape how organisations innovate, serve customers and run operations over the coming years.
His appointment places an experienced enterprise technology executive at the centre of Meta’s commercial AI strategy as competition intensifies among major technology companies.
Desai joins the initiative after serving as CEO of MongoDB , one of the world's leading database software companies.
